answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the cedar accrues. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the quartz of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the ripple behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal 1eddx.
